canonical_project: Google Christmas Island connectivity hub / reported AI data centre
notes: Google officially announced a Christmas Island connectivity hub as part of Dhivaru on 2025-11-17, with cable switching, content caching and colocation capabilities. ABC reported on 2025-11-29 that Google wants a connectivity hub on Christmas Island involving at least four subsea cable projects and that the minister confirmed lease talks with the shire near the local airport. Reuters reporting, summarized by Capital Brief and Submarine Networks, described advanced talks for a data hub/data centre near the airport and cited a 7 MW long-term power request; Google denied constructing a large AI data centre and framed the work as subsea cable infrastructure. Capacity is therefore from Reuters-reported local-source information, not an official Google figure.
